svg.title: Section through the removable subfloor vent hood
svg.desc: Downward intake between a free sill drip and an outer skirt. The projected roof edge falls on the hood.

g.text: Where rain meets the subfloor vent
West and east mouths · local section looking along the wall · dimensions in millimetres
The metal hood takes the drip
The roof edge projects 50 past the screen at all four mouths.
The cap and sill slope outwards at 1 in 10.
The skirt ends 20 below the sill tip.
100 clear at the intake gives 40,000 mm².
The framed screen reduces this to 29,000 mm².
Remove the hood from outside to reach the screen.
Study geometry. Wind-driven rain, splash, discharge, framing and installed pressure loss require testing.
